changes.text: Keep at least 20% in GBP money market until the Fed and BoE paths are clear
changes.rationale: Dry powder earning ~Bank Rate during a hiking cycle; lets the agent buy dislocations after FOMC 27-28 Oct and BoE 5 Nov

changes.text: Halve energy exposure if Brent closes below its 50-day average
changes.rationale: Energy is the core inflation trade; a break in oil's trend is the first sign the regime is turning

changes.text: Rotate money market into gilts if the US 10-year falls 30bp from 5.22% or payrolls turn negative
changes.rationale: Pre-commits the pivot trade so the agent acts on the regime change instead of debating it
